szoveg_eredeti:
What kind of AIs do we really want in the world? Our Humanist AI Code of Conduct lays out how we're thinking about this at Microsoft. 

This summer's cyber incidents were a critical warning shot and it's important we all now pay attention to why we are building this technology and how we will ensure its aligned and contained to human interests and values.

Please take a look and give us feedback. The public consultation period is closing in 3 weeks. We really want to get your input: https://microsoft.ai/news/mai-code-of-conduct/
